rules: Authored before any scoring run against this set, after the holdout30 gate (reply wording that called the ticket urgent, fixed at the tool result and scored).
limitations: 45 cases in 5 small-business domains, English only, single provider/model per run: not a general measure of answer quality.
Pattern/substring checks are a proxy; a human rubric review of a sample is still required (docs/evidence/l1.4).
supersedes: holdout30 (consumed 2026-11-05: valid 8/8 but 5 of 15 failed-tool replies called the ticket urgent).
